read.thesis: Record refining margins and LNG trading lifted adjusted net income to $9.1bn (+50% QoQ) and CFFO to $12.3bn; FY26 CFFO guided to $42-43bn with 40% payout, but upstream growth is supply-disciplined at only ~3% p.a. to 2030.

utilisation.quote: Running our refineries at full capacity, optimizing utilization resulted in an increase of nearly 10% of our refining throughput this quarter

capex.quote: Net investment remained disciplined at $3.3 billion in the third quarter, in line with the annual guidance of a full year 2026 net investment of $15 billion.

triggers.label: European refining margin $33.2/bbl, 2.5x QoQ
triggers.quote: supported by an unprecedented combination of unavailability of Russian refining capacity, the disruption of the supply from the Middle East, and global inventories at historical lows.

triggers.label: FY26 CFFO raised to $42-43bn
triggers.quote: the full year 2026 cash flow is now expected to be above $42 billion and maybe around even reaching $43 billion

triggers.label: Upstream growth capped at ~3% p.a. to 2030
triggers.quote: All the projects contributing to achieving the upstream production growth targets of more than 3% per year by 2030 are in execution phase.

triggers.label: Conflict production hit ~5%
triggers.quote: The impact of the crisis in the Middle East on TotalEnergies' overall production was reduced to around 5% over the quarter on average

guidance.quote: the full year 2026 cash flow is now expected to be above $42 billion and maybe around even reaching $43 billion
in line with the annual guidance of a full year 2026 net investment of $15 billion

guidance.value: 40% of cash flow; $2.5bn buybacks in Q4 26 and Q1 27
guidance.quote: reiterates its commitment to return 40% of cash flow to shareholders
TotalEnergies is therefore on track to reach its annual objective in Integrated Power business to generate more than 60 terawatt hour over the year.
already below the 10% level we guide at CMD for end 2026.
the upstream production growth targets of more than 3% per year by 2030 are in execution phase
the company anticipates an average LNG selling price above $14 per million BTU for the first quarter 2026

red_flags.label: Yamal LNG EU exit from Jan 2027
red_flags.quote: from January 2027, Yamal LNG will not come to Europe anymore, to the EU, by the sanctions regime

red_flags.label: Hormuz LNG flows at ~25% of pre-war
red_flags.quote: We had only 25% of the normal LNG tankers flow going through the Strait of Hormuz compared to pre-war.

red_flags.quote: we have made some write-off on some of these concessions
